checked.how: getTrack throws on an unknown id (src/content/tracks.ts:22-25) and nextTrackId throws on a missing id, so the test can't pass silently. The test checks the name, laps, width >= 11, validateTrack, TRACKS[0].id === 'bends', dust-bowl -> hay-loop and hay-loop -> bends. Renaming, re-ordering or narrowing the track would each fail it.

Hairpin: largest net heading change within 50 units of the 1-unit dense centre, asserted >= 150°. S-bend: >= 40° one way, then the other way within 120 units, outside the hairpin. Gap: only window endpoints are tested against the hairpin. Hand-computed neck headings (+32°, -186°, +32°, -25°) show no surviving mutation, so not reported.

An O(n²) check over every dense-centre pair more than 60 units apart along the lap, at width + 2, matching the spec. It also checks exactly one ramp in both the data and the layout. The lip is checked through ramps[0].at, which is the lip position (track.ts:201 samples the lip at r.at*length), so moving the ramp outside 0.35–0.65 fails.

Every prop gets the half+1 clearance check (nearest 1-unit sample). It counts bales inside and tyres outside within 5 units of the edge at hairpin indices only. Swapping row sides, moving rows off the hairpin, or offset > 5 would fail it. The teardrop interior is inside the loop polygon, so insideLoop is right here.
Counts cone trees inside the closed centreline polygon (even-odd test) whose nearest centre distance is more than half the width, and asserts >= 8. Removing the free-standing props would fail it.

helpers.ts watch() tracks grass, prop contact (SAT, independent of car.ts) and the longest slow run over all cars. finished only when every car finishes. AC4: one run per seed; 3 laps, 0 grass, 0 prop, slow < BOT_TUNING.stuckTicks; median = sorted[7] of 15. AC5: seeds 1–5, 6 cars, finishTick <= 5 min, stuck check. Nothing trivial.

The test counts PlacedProp entries per kind across the prop-cell meshes and checks them with toEqual against the layout's per-kind counts plus ramp count. It uses the same 'props'/'prop-cell' seam as the existing tests/render/scene.test.ts (scene.ts:9,105), so the counts come from the layout rather than from numbers the test sets itself.
